title: Remove repeated order rows
prompt: The nightly export sometimes delivers the same order row more than once, which doubles revenue on the dashboard. Write `solve(orders)` so it returns the orders with each exact copy removed.
rules: Two rows are copies only when every column matches. Keep one of them.
Rows for the same order that differ in any value, even only the status or the case of a word, are both kept.
Two missing values in the same column count as matching.
hints: You don't need to pick key columns here.
`distinct()` and `dropDuplicates()` with no arguments compare whole rows.
`dropDuplicates(["order_id"])` would merge rows that differ, which isn't asked for.
starter:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
